name: Dex2/5
summary: Dex2/5 is Unitree's compact five-finger tendon-driven hand for G1 and R1 humanoid integration. It has 10 total degrees of freedom controlled by two actuators: one for the thumb and one shared by the remaining four fingers. The manufacturer lists a 365 g mass, RS485 communication and internal wiring intended to reduce exposed cables. Control feedback includes joint position, velocity and torque. Its 1.5 kg load figure applies to the specified grasp of a 5 cm round hard object at room temperature, rather than every manipulation task.
